release package.test results: shown on the run's Summary page

team.how a release happens today: Every change goes through a pull request; the tests run on it automatically and one other developer reviews it. After a merge, whoever merged runs a deploy script from their own laptop (about 15 minutes) and watches the error log for 30 minutes. The team merges several changes a day, so the script runs many times a day, and last week it was forgotten twice. Undoing a release takes under 10 minutes with the same script.
team.tests today: run automatically on every pull request
team.who checks a release: the tests and one other developer
